actions.label: Reproduce Keyboard Manager Bluetooth media interaction behavior

reproduce.expected: Media transport input should not strand shortcut state or require session lock/unlock to recover normal remapping.
steps: On a disposable current-build system configure only Ctrl+Tab to Alt+Tab and verify repeated switching between test windows.
Trigger play/pause from a Bluetooth headset, then repeat the exact shortcut while recording physical/virtual modifier state and engine liveness.
Compare keyboard media key and ordinary shortcut controls, including holding versus releasing modifiers during the media action.
prerequisites: Use a disposable test environment and test-owned documents/configuration; preserve existing user data.

known_information: The report supplies Ctrl+Tab to Alt+Tab and says a Bluetooth headphone play/pause action makes remapping stop until lock/unlock.
No specific headphone model or runtime event trace is supplied. Bot-suggested related issues are not confirmed duplicates.
Current shortcut handling tracks original/injected modifier state; a non-keyboard media action can be tested independently from normal key release.
inferences: The proposed mechanism is provisional and is not an executed runtime result or evidence that the old report is fixed.
